_note: Retrieval record for the INSTRUMENTS the fusion-junction ASO manuscript's Methods runs on — the transcript source, the sequence sets, the aligner, the fold and the two expression atlases. Every identifier below was RETURNED BY A EUROPE PMC SEARCH RUN ON A GITHUB RUNNER on 2026-08-14 and every field is quoted from that returned record; none was typed from recollection. This file is the ANCHOR research/manuscripts/lint_citations.py checks those prose identifiers against.
_limits: An identifier returned by Europe PMC is evidence the RECORD EXISTS with that title and journal. It is NOT evidence that the paper supports the sentence it is attached to; that check is human.

These are resource/tool citations. Citing a database's release paper does not establish which release was used — no Ensembl release number is recorded in this repository's artefacts, so none is claimed.

known_positive_control.why: Left empty deliberately, per the workflow's own guidance: a control must be a paper the query would actually return. These queries are exact-title searches for the resource papers themselves, so the returned records ARE the control — each requested title came back, and the two that did not (GTEx v8 and the HPA tissue map, absent from the first corpus) are why a second query was run rather than a near-vintage paper being substituted.

supplementary_record_2026_08_31_the_five._why_here: The journal article used to enumerate all five steps of PMID 39912803's workflow inline, 33 words of a cited framework in a 6-page paper. The paper now states only its own SCOPE — the in-silico half of step 1, and step 3's margin measurement in the Discussion — because that is the paper's claim; the enumeration is the source's, and this is where it lives. ⛔ THE ENUMERATION HAD NO OTHER HOME: the extended report never carried it and is a frozen deposited checkpoint that cannot gain one, so cutting it from the article without this record would have removed it from the repository entirely.

record.title: Assessing Hybridization-Dependent Off-Target Risk for Therapeutic Oligonucleotides: Updated Industry Recommendations.
record.five_steps_verbatim: The proposed workflow encompasses five key steps: (1) OffT identification throughcomplementarity prediction and transcriptomics analysis, (2) focus on cell types with relevant ONT activity, (3)verification and margin assessment, (4) risk assessment based on the OffT biological role, and (5) management of unavoidable OffTs.
record.⚠_the_two_missing_spaces_are_the_sources: "through"+"complementarity" and "(3)"+"verification" run together in the abstract as PubMed serves it. Retained rather than tidied: a verbatim field that has been silently corrected is no longer a verbatim field, and the whole value of one is that a reader can match it against the source byte for byte.
record.what_the_paper_takes_from_it: Step 1 is the only in-silico step and this work performs its in-silico half and stops; steps 2, 3, 4 and 5 are laboratory or governance steps this project has never done. Step 3 is the margin assessment the Discussion's falsification design specifies. ⛔ THE PAPER MAY NOT CLAIM MORE THAN STEP 1 — `test_the_manuscript_asserts_the_relation_its_artifacts_compute.py` forbids 'all five', 'the first three steps' and 'steps one to' at that sentence by name.
record.role: The committed home of the framework the paper locates its own scope against.
